name: l2cap_le_connection_response_handler

ownership.argument: This is the module-visible accept/reject decision path: it is the only public wrapper whose handler emits the 0x15 response for a channel whose state is already 2. Named after what it actually does rather than after the decision the app made.

provenance.source: Submitted by the public wrapper 0xC805BBC. Takes the cid from request+0, finds the channel by channel+116, and branches on the channel state byte +120: state 2 emits the LE Credit Based Connection Response through 0xC8025C0 using the channel result byte at +121, states 8..9 close through 0xC800A94, and any other state tears the channel down through 0xC801124 with reason 1033.

notes: This is the module-visible accept/reject decision path: it is the only public wrapper whose handler emits the 0x15 response for a channel whose state is already 2. Named after what it actually does rather than after the decision the app made.
